content:
Amy: heads up — noticed a sawtooth pattern of packet loss and 95th/99th latency spikes for gpu-training pods in eu-west2 after the CNI rollout earlier
Raj: which rollout? did we push the cni daemonset change at 09:12?
Amy: yep, cni image bump + tunnel rewrite landed ~09:12, rollout finished ~09:30 partially across canaries then all nodes
Amy: symptoms: intermittent retransmits between pods on same node and across racks, cpu/gpu jobs slow tails, some RDMA jobs outright fail
sre-bot: alert: pod-network-packetloss-high (eu-west2) — 18 clusters affected, avg packet_loss 2.6% over 5m :rotating_light:
Marta: any MTU mismatches in the upgrade? we changed encapsulation handling in that PR
Amy: good call — mtu probe shows ICMP "fragmentation needed" on a few nodes, host MTU 9000, pod veth shows 1400
Amy: paste of one node's dmesg log:
```
May 10 09:37:12 host-024 kernel: Cilium: geneve_xmit failed: local mtu 9000, encap needs 1404 -> ICMP frag needed
May 10 09:37:12 host-024 kernel: rdma: mlx5: reregister_mr timed out, handshake stalled
```
Raj: seeing identical rdma handshake timeouts in logs from training pool, likely >100ms tail latency killing handshake windows
Kai: ran iperf between two affected pods (same host): 0.8% loss sustained, tcp retransmits spike when p99 token servir appears
Amy: also ran `kubectl exec` from pod A to pod B, ping -s 1400 shows no loss but ping -s 8900 fails with "Frag Needed"
Marta: that suggests encapsulation added ~50-70 bytes after rewrite, MTU path not adapted. CNI should have set lower MTU on pod interfaces but our new code only set it for tun/geneve when overlay-mode=explicit
Raj: can we toggle `cni-config.tunnelMode=bare` for canaries to test? or roll back to previous manifest
Amy: quick mitigation: rolled back CNI on 3 canary nodes at 10:05 — they report normal latency and no RDMA timeouts (so rollback validated)
Kai: created a small k8s job to toggle mtu on pods as a temp workaround: `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` in initContainer — works but ugly
Marta: plan: 1) rollback the global rollout to previous CNI image (approved) 2) patch tunnel MTU handling in codebase and add explicit path MTU probe in init 3) run canary again
Amy: opened an incident ticket: INC-2026-472 (linked) and added trace logs, perf histograms and sample pcap
deploy-bot: rollback started for cni-daemonset v2 -> v1.21 at 10:12 by @Amy
Raj: follow-ups: add e2e test for RDMA handshake under varying MTU, add iperf/packet loss sim in upgrade job
Marta: also we should add a policy to prevent geneve rewrite toggles without mtu fallback in future PRs
Amy: assigning follow-ups: @Raj to tests, @Kai to canary rollout verification, @Marta to PR for mtu probe
Kai: will monitor eu-west2 training queues and update this thread, pushing dashboards for p99 packet-loss by node
Amy: thanks — marking incident as active and will update when global rollback completes or if we need further remediation :white_check_mark:
